review.imagery: Thirteen project renders were visually reviewed. Eight native brochure scenes and five current-gallery views cover the tower, retail podium, entrance, facade, office/lobby concepts and leisure spaces. The complete tower exterior supplies the card and hero with top-aligned focal positioning. Generic office/retail people photographs, unpainted stock resources and duplicate crops are excluded. Proposed unit fitout remains unverified. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Sixteen complete building sheets come from a Mitchell’s Commercial Realty mirror of the SAMANA-branded office plan pack. They cover floors 1–25, including grouped typical floors and the mechanical level. The copied Retail Type legend labels offices. Individual unit drawings, numerical areas and ground-floor retail plans were not established. Confirm approved boundaries, fitout and area with SAMANA. All sixteen complete physical drawing pages 2–17 and the branded cover were visually reviewed. Each floor and typical-floor range remains separately selectable. Mechanical-floor office/amenity scope is retained. Broad primary office/retail minimums are not assigned to a particular floorplate, and office sheets are not mislabeled as individual retail units.
review.location: Complete official brochure travel panel page 7 and regional map page 8 were visually reviewed. Primary/brochure DXB travel differences remain explicit. The official q value 25.091841852662657, 55.31089682658287 is saved with source hash and six-place rounding. No road distance, live route or precise entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and the original official brochure retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. The office pack and comparison factsheet are broker-hosted, with the selected pack clearly attributed to Mitchell’s Commercial Realty. Native image origins, complete drawing sheets and physical-page links remain available. Protected commercial/text research is preserved.

unavailable: Individual unit drawings, numerical drawing-specific areas, ground-floor retail plans, final approved fitout, a verified entrance and dated construction photographs were not established. The available office floorplates retain their broker-mirror attribution.
